title: Telling the Story of Animal Farm
prompt: Animal Farm is told by a narrator who seems to know only what the ordinary animals know. In about five paragraphs, analyze how this point of view shapes what readers understand about the pigs and the other animals, and how the order in which Orwell tells events (for example, the changing commandments) affects the reader. Support your analysis with specific quotations and explain them. Use a clear claim, logical organization with transitions, and a conclusion, and proofread for conventions.
